steps: library: a style is available before any project exists
create: a vertical project, 25 fps, 720 short edge, a profile and a style
stored: shape, rate, profile and look are on the project, not implied by a form
brief: a session reads the film's shape and profile without opening a form
style: an entry with no style of its own is written with the project's look
frame: generated at 720x1280, the vertical shape the project was created with
cut: rendered at the same 720x1280, from settings rather than a flag
ui: the create form asks for shape, rate, models and a look
ui: the new project states 1080x1920 at 25 fps and its look
